# MIMRY

> MIMRY is a local CLI and MCP server that gives AI coding agents a memory of a code repository. It indexes a repo, keeps the index fresh incrementally, and answers "which files matter for this task?" with ranked, evidence-backed files and a written context pack. Everything runs on the user's machine: no code upload, no remote embeddings, no telemetry.

Install with `uv tool install mimry` (or `pipx install mimry`, `pip install mimry`); Python 3.11+ on Windows, Linux, or macOS. This provides `mimry` (CLI) and `mimry-mcp` (MCP server, stdio).

Agent workflow in a repo:

1. `mimry preflight "<task>"` sets MIMRY up if needed and prints the files to read first.
2. Read the context pack that preflight names (printed as `Context pack:`, returned as `context_path`), for example `.mimry/mimry-out/context/<task>-<hash>.md`: ranked files with reasons, key symbols, relationships, risky paths, and verification commands.
3. Navigate with focused queries instead of exploring by grep: `mimry find "<query>"`, `mimry symbol <name>`, `mimry callers <name>`, `mimry callees <name>`, `mimry related "<query>"`, `mimry explain "<task>"`, `mimry path <a> <b>`, `mimry why <file> --query "<task>"`. For an exact string you already know, use `rg` (or `git grep`) directly.
4. Verify against real source, tests, and build output. MIMRY output is navigation, not proof.
5. Record what helped: `mimry feedback --query "<task>" --opened <files> --changed <files> --verification "<result>" --outcome passed`.

`preflight`, `context`, `brief`, `route`, `find`, `symbol`, `related` and `semantic` reindex first when files changed or MIMRY was upgraded; if another lookup reports the index is out of date, run `mimry reindex`. Piped output uses ASCII marks (`OK`, `!`, `x`); exit code 0 is ok, 1 is not set up, 2 is stale or an error. `mimry route "<task>" --json` returns structured data.

Connect as an MCP server: `claude mcp add --scope user mimry -- mimry-mcp` (Claude Code), `codex mcp add mimry -- mimry-mcp` (Codex), or `{"mcpServers": {"mimry": {"command": "mimry-mcp"}}}` for other clients. By default the server lists 8 tools: `mimry_preflight`, `mimry_find`, `mimry_symbol`, `mimry_related`, `mimry_why`, `mimry_path`, `mimry_status` and `mimry_feedback`; each accepts an optional `root`.
Set `MIMRY_MCP_TOOLS=all` to list every MIMRY tool, or give a comma-separated list of tool names. Commands with no tool, such as `mimry callers`, `mimry bench` and `mimry doctor`, are CLI-only.

## Docs

- [Claude Code setup](https://jbacalso24.github.io/mimry/claude-code/): connect the MCP server, install the project workflow and hooks, verify status, and start a task
- [Codex setup](https://jbacalso24.github.io/mimry/codex/): connect the MCP server, install the Codex project skill and hooks, verify status, and start a task
- [How MIMRY retrieves context](https://jbacalso24.github.io/mimry/context-retrieval/): freshness, indexing, ranking evidence, context packs, source verification, and feedback
- [README](https://github.com/jbacalso24/mimry/blob/main/README.md): what MIMRY is, install, quickstart, agent workflow, MCP setup, and every command
- [Context packs](https://github.com/jbacalso24/mimry/blob/main/docs/context-packs.md): the section contract of the context pack preflight prints (`.mimry/mimry-out/context/<task>-<hash>.md`)
- [Adapters](https://github.com/jbacalso24/mimry/blob/main/docs/adapters.md): the file-type adapters and what each extracts
- [Determinism](https://github.com/jbacalso24/mimry/blob/main/docs/determinism.md): which index state is canonical and reproducible
